name: Salado
seo_title: Salado Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 7 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Salado, Texas for 2026: a lighted parade, the Christmas Stroll, a trail of lights and a stage show, with dates checked.
lede: Salado turns historic Main Street into a holiday stroll with a lighted parade, carriage rides and late night shopping, and Tablerock adds a trail of lights, outdoor movies and a stage play.
celebrates: The Salado Chamber of Commerce presents the Christmas Stroll over the first two weekends of December, with late night shopping, carriage rides, pictures with Santa and live entertainment on Main Street. The chamber's Lighted Christmas Parade opens the season. Tablerock, a nonprofit amphitheater and park on Royal Street, lights a walking trail for the holidays, shows Christmas movies and stages A Christmas Carol. Salado Public Library adds story times and a Santa visit for kids.
lastyear: The chamber's 2024 listing for the 64th annual Salado Christmas Stroll gave Saturday, December 7, 2024, from 10 am to 8 pm, within the first two weekends of December. It listed late night shopping, carriage rides, pictures with Santa, live entertainment and local business events along Main Street. A video from the 65th Stroll shows the tradition continued in 2025. We did not find a detailed 2025 attendance recap.
facts: Visit Salado describes the village as historic buildings along Salado Creek that throws a beloved Christmas Stroll every year. The 2026 Stroll is the 66th annual, according to the chamber. The Salado Ladies Community League also holds a Christmas in October Jingle Walk, a three day shopping event that reached its 46th year in 2025, so the village starts its holiday season early.
trains: Salado does not have a holiday train of its own that we could verify. Families who want trains nearby can visit the Temple Railroad and Heritage Museum in Temple, a Santa Fe depot shared with Amtrak, which lists adults at $4 and kids 4 and under free on our museum guide.
train_links: A Santa Fe depot shared with Amtrak, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: The Salado Chamber of Commerce's two weekend Main Street tradition, now in its 66th year, with carriage rides, shops and live entertainment.
The chamber's parade that kicks off the Stroll, with floats and decorated golf carts.
Tablerock's walking trail of more than a half mile of lights, open by donation.
Tablerock's stage production at the Goodnight Amphitheater, now in its 34th year.
The Salado Ladies Community League's early shopping weekend, held for 46 years.
kidfact: Salado's Christmas Trail of Lights has a lighted creek, glowing bridges and tunnels of lights that kids can walk through.
faq: The Salado Chamber of Commerce hosts a Lighted Christmas Parade and the Christmas Stroll on Main Street, with carriage rides, late night shopping and live entertainment. Tablerock adds a Trail of Lights, Christmas movies and A Christmas Carol, and the public library offers kids programs and a Santa visit.
How long has the Salado Christmas Stroll been held?
The chamber lists the 2026 event as the 66th annual Salado Christmas Stroll. It takes place over the first two weekends of December, according to the chamber.
Is there a Salado event with lights for kids?
Yes. Tablerock's Christmas Trail of Lights is a walking trail of more than half a mile with a lighted creek, bridges, archways and tunnels. Tablerock lists entry by donation.
Can kids see a play in Salado at Christmas?

Tablerock stages A Christmas Carol each December at the Goodnight Amphitheater, an outdoor venue on Royal Street. The ticket page tags it as a kids and family event, and the 2026 run is its 34th year.
Where can kids meet Santa in Salado?
The Stroll has traditionally included pictures with Santa on Main Street, and Salado Public Library holds a Santa meet and greet with a picture and a treat. Check each host page for the current date.
sources: Tablerock Amphitheater and Trail of Lights
intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Salado for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 13 (Salado Glassworks ornament event) through December 31 (the Christmas Trail of Lights at Tablerock), with the Lighted Christmas Parade (December 3), the 66th Annual Christmas Stroll (December 4 to 13) and A Christmas Carol at the Goodnight Amphitheater (December 11 to 19) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Salado

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Salado
  • 1 free event: the Salado Lighted Christmas Parade on December 3
  • Meet Santa: the Salado Public Library Santa meet and greet (December 18)
  • Parades and strolls: the Lighted Christmas Parade (December 3) and the 66th Annual Christmas Stroll on Main Street (December 4 to 13)
  • Lights and shows: the Christmas Trail of Lights at Tablerock (nightly from November 28), Christmas Movie Nights (December 4 and 5) and A Christmas Carol (December 11 to 19)
  • Crafts: ornament making at Salado Glassworks and holiday programs at Salado Public Library
  • Season: November 13 to December 31
